messages:
laura: FYI procurement sent back the proposals from InvoicePilot and ReconcilePro. both pretty different on pricing/take rate. need quick sanity check before i reply.
miguel: share the excerpts? especially curious about how they handle credit notes and chargebacks.
laura: InvoicePilot snippet: 
```
InvoicePilot enterprise: $0.06 per invoice processed (includes header + line-item OCR) or $0.045 at 100k+/mo. Attachments $0.008/page. Min commit $45k/yr. SSO included. Onboarding: 20h included, additional PS billed $250/hr.
```

reconcilepro snippet: 
```
ReconcilePro: $0.04 per invoice tiered at 0-50k/50k-200k/200k+; line-item extraction billed separately at $0.002 per line. Enterprise package: $50k commit includes 40h onboarding and 5 connectors. Per-page attachment fees waived if attachments sent via S3.
```

tom: Hmm ReconcilePro's line-item charge could blow up with nested invoices. we need guarantee on cost predictability.
contracts: note: check termination language and SLAs. if they have per-line charges, ask for a monthly cap.
finance-ops: Must check: 1) output schema must include GL account, tax breakdown, discount lines, FX fields, and a delta flag for matched vs unmatched; 2) webhook + S3 export required; 3) audit log retention 7yrs; 4) processing SLA: nightly batches <3h, ad-hoc <30m.
miguel: propose we ask both vendors for: a) sample mapped payload for our sample export b) a cost model spreadsheet at our projected 1.4M/yr showing best/worst case (with line counts) c) contract language for audit log + DPA + KMS + subprocessor list.
laura: Draft questions to send: 
- Can you ingest our BigQuery export and associated GCS attachments? Any schema gaps?
- How do you count line items vs fields vs pages? Provide exact formula.
- Provide a sample invoice showing monthly charges at low/expected/high volume for 12/24 month terms, include PS and onboarding.
- Will you cap monthly charges or allow a max per-invoice effective rate?
- Do you include SSO (SAML + SCIM) + provisioning in enterprise?
- Can reconciliation rules/GL mappings be exported (YAML/JSON) and stored in our repo?
- What rollback and versioning support do you provide for mapping regressions?
- Will you sign our DPA and support KMS key control/HSM? List subcontractors.
- Sample SLA language for processing latency and accuracy targets. Can we get a 30-day right to exit if accuracy < benchmark post-onboarding?
- Do you provide Delta webhooks for unmatched rate alerts and a historical audit feed to S3?

procurement-bot: Reminder: attach RFP + sample dataset and use /procure/reply-template-v1. Also include cost spreadsheet template.
laura: Also add: ask whether credits or refunds are provided for systemic errors or misses on acceptance tests. We should push for measurable remedies (credits, extra PS).
miguel: negotiation levers: longer commit for lower per-invoice, remove per-page fee if attachments come via our OCR pipeline, include X hours of PS and three custom connectors included in year 1, and an accuracy SLA tied to credits.
contracts: if they refuse rule export or audit log retention, it's a hard stop for us.
finance-ops: tag me in the reply. i'll validate the sample payload and run it through our downstream checks.
laura: ok i'll send consolidated questions to both vendors tonight and paste replies here for review. thanks all :ok_hand:
